title: coelogyne lepida
intro: Coelogyne lepida, commonly known as the 'Ghost Orchid', is a type of epiphytic orchid species belonging to the family Orchidaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including the reduction of inflammation and improvement of respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Coelogyne lepida are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which may include flavonoids and phenolic compounds, although further research is required to fully elucidate its effects.
